pages.title: Many Rooms
pages.text: I can make as many rooms as I like, and name them. The gate lists them. It lists my other gates too.$(br2)A room I no longer want can be $(thing)deleted$() from that list. Everything in it goes with it. It asks me twice, and it should.

pages.title: Guests
pages.text: A room can be shared with someone, by name, and they can then open a gate of their own onto it.$(br2)I wrote that down because it works. I have had no one to try it with.
